page.title: Mount Bromo Logistics

hero.heading: Mount Bromo: jeep, timing & sunrise.
hero.lede: Bromo sunrise means a 00:30-01:00 hotel pickup and a private 4WD jeep transfer to King Kong Hill or Penanjakan at 2,329m altitude. JVTO sequences the night so your vehicle reaches the right viewpoint before the jeep pool at Cemoro Lawang clears.

payload.intro: The Bromo sunrise window is short, the access road is single-lane in places, and the jeep pool at Cemoro Lawang clears in waves. Pacing is everything.

items.description: Pickup at your hotel in Surabaya / Probolinggo / Cemoro Lawang.
Arrive at Cemoro Lawang. Hot drink stop.
King Kong Hill or Penanjakan 1 viewpoint, depending on route and conditions.
Descend to the sea of sand for the crater walk.
Return to Cemoro Lawang for breakfast.

sections.title: Viewpoints
sections.body_md: JVTO defaults to King Kong Hill for balanced framing, Penanjakan 1 for the classic shot, Seruni Point when avoiding crowds matters most, and Mentigen Hill for guests staying in Cemoro Lawang.

sections.title: Vehicle & temperature
sections.body_md: Our 4WD jeeps seat up to 6. Heating is limited. We supply blankets and hot drinks at the viewpoint. Expect 3-8°C at the rim in dry season; freezing in July/August.

sections.title: What to wear
items: Thermal base layer + fleece + windbreaker (4-5 layers in winter).
Hiking shoes with grip - the caldera floor is volcanic sand.
Buff or scarf for ash protection during the crater walk.
Headlamp - JVTO supplies one if you do not have it.

sections.title: The crater walk
sections.body_md: From the jeep drop-off it is a 30-minute walk across the sea of sand, then 253 stone steps up the cone. Horses are available locally; JVTO does not bundle them by default for animal-welfare reasons.
